regime.label: Fearful, no panic
regime.summary: S&P 500 about 7,315 (-0.3% Wed), near its lowest close since July. VIX about 24.5. 10-year 5.07%. Fed minutes: almost all officials see more hikes. VIX under 30: never sell long-term holdings.

brief: Stocks gave back early gains after hawkish Fed minutes (S&P 500 -0.3%, VIX about 24.5). Cerebras is $93.51, under its $100 stop: sell at 00:30 Dubai if still below $100. No new buy, no lab trade.

todo.focus: Anthropic trades for the first time. Watch, don't chase.

items.text: Do NOT buy Anthropic (ANT) on its first day, even if it flies

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: BUY 2 with a limit at CHF 170, valid until Fri Nov 27. Closed CHF 175.45 Wed (low 172.00): not filled. Keep the limit, do not chase. SIX, or ADR CFRUY.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: The $335 limit likely filled (low $332.42 Wed). If not filled, keep it until Fri Nov 20; cancel if ETN closes below $327.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), full-year guide raised. 29% below its high at about 22x next year's profit.

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: The $86.22 limit likely filled (low $85.76 Wed). Then BUY 6 more each week while below $91.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. About 3.5% below its high after a -3% month.

cards.name: EVENT: Nvidia beat and guided $130B
cards.trigger: HOLD. No add. Earliest review of an add: Fri Nov 20 close (2-session rule), and only if it holds above $160.
cards.story: The business is fine; the stock is held back by the CEO exit, slower cash collection and a lower margin guide.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit filled. WAIT on a second slice until the 2027 capex figure (early Feb) and search growth of at least 12%.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. Fell on a profit miss partly from a one-off investment loss.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: WAIT. Cancel the EUR 48.50 limit if placed. Reconsider Fri Nov 27 only if IFX closed above EUR 46 every day and no new US chip rule hits Europe.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips, but the cash flow guide (about EUR 1.8bn) is below the EUR 2bn hoped for.

cards.name: Experian · London
cards.trigger: WAIT. Reconsider after Fri Nov 20 close: BUY up to 12 shares at or below that close, only if above 2,800p and no target cuts.
cards.story: EPS +15% and an extra $500M buyback, but the top of its growth guide was cut. 16.5% below its January high.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT: BUY 2 only with a limit at EUR 235 (about EUR 240.60 Wed), valid until Fri Nov 27. Paris hours 12:00-20:30 Dubai, or US OTC SBGSY.
cards.story: Organic growth +17%, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal and a Middle East warning, not demand.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: WAIT. Closed $359.69 Tue, about $376 pre-market after Nvidia. BUY 1 only after a close above $385, limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Software AI fear: Salesforce, SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before Salesforce results Wed Dec 2. From Fri Dec 4: reconsider 2 CRM at or below that close if organic growth holds and no guide is cut.
cards.story: Without acquisitions Salesforce grows only about 6-7%. Cheap at about 15x next year's profit, but not yet a buy.

cards.name: UnitedHealth
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy: the drop comes from a new rule that can cut payments. Reconsider after the comment period ends (Jan 19, 2027).
cards.story: About -10% on a proposed Medicare audit rule. The business was improving, but clawbacks are a real risk.

cards.name: Take-Two (GTA VI)
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy into the GTA VI launch (Thu Nov 19). Reconsider after the first sales update, only if TTWO is still below $220.
cards.story: The launch is huge, but last quarter net bookings fell 18% and recurring player spending fell 9%.

cards.name: Netflix
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after Q4 results (Jan 2027) only if the ad outlook is not cut again and viewing hours are not shrinking.
cards.story: At a 52-week low after cutting its ad outlook. Profits are strong, but growth is slowing while YouTube gains viewing time.

cards.name: ABB · Zurich
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after Q4 results (Thu Jan 28, 2027) only if book-to-bill stays above 1 and the China part of the Robotics sale is resolved.
cards.story: Orders +40%, but they ride the data-center cycle, profit missed and China blocked part of its Robotics sale.

cards.name: Nike
cards.trigger: AVOID. Sales are still shrinking. Reconsider only after a quarter with sales growth.
cards.story: -6.3% after its investor day pushed the recovery out. Sales fell 5% and free cash flow did not cover the dividend.

cards.name: Prosus · Amsterdam
cards.trigger: AVOID. No buy before its H1 results on Wed Nov 25; reconsider only if Tencent's profit grows again.
cards.story: -5% to -7% on Tencent's Q3 revenue miss. Tencent is about 73% of its assets and its profit is falling on AI spending.
